sources: recreation.gov public campsite search for facility 233746 (per-site catalog), read 2026-10-22

values.note: $26/night peak season including 2 vehicles (or RV/trailer plus tow vehicle); $9/night per additional vehicle, which interagency passes do not discount. Group site 12 $50/night. 'Off Season, there is no fee and no amenities available.' Firewood $10/bundle.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/spire-rock-campground ('Single Site: $26 per night', 'Group Site: $50 per night', 'Off Season, there is no fee and no amenities available', '$9.00 each additional vehicle'; updated May 5, 2026) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233746/rates (2026 Peak Season 2026-05-15 to 2026-09-26: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 26, GROUP 50), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Reserve on recreation.gov; reserved sites are held until check-out time on the day after the scheduled arrival. Run by the concessionaire Rocky Mountain Recreation Company (ExplorUS).

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233746 (rules: maxConsecutiveStay 16; notice 'Reserved campsites will be held until check-out time on the day following your scheduled arrival') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/spire-rock-campground ('View this site on Recreation.gov'; Contact: Rocky Mountain Recreation Company), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: '5/16-9/30 Weather Dependent.' Storm Castle Creek Rd is open 5/16-12/31; off season there is no fee and no amenities.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/spire-rock-campground (Seasons of Use '5/16-9/30 Weather Dependent.'; Directions 'Road open 5/16 – 12/31'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 233746 (all 20 sites typed STANDARD NONELECTRIC or GROUP STANDARD NONELECTRIC, water hookup 'No'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: No drinking water: bring your own. Trash pickup, recycling, food storage lockers, host; firewood sold on site. Gravel roads and parking spurs.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/spire-rock-campground ('vault toilets', 'No drinking water is available in the campground', 'No RV Dump Station', 'There are NO Shower facilities', 'Trash Pickup: Yes') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233746 (amenities), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The Forest Service page says 17 campsites; the recreation.gov catalog lists 20 (18 reservable single sites, a host site, an unreservable site and group site 12). No per-site lengths published; average RV parking spur 25 x 50 ft.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/spire-rock-campground ('Camp sites: 17', 'Trailer/RV Sites Average Parking Spur: 25’ x 50') + recreation.gov campsite catalog for 233746, read 2026-10-22

note: Along Storm Castle Creek (a Gallatin River tributary), Custer Gallatin NF (Bozeman RD), 23 mi south of Bozeman on US-191 then 2-3 mi east on gravel Storm Castle Creek Rd; most sites along the creek under spruce and fir. Storm Castle and Garnet Mountain Lookout trails nearby. Bears (grizzly and black) in the canyon. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated May 5, 2026) + recreation.gov: confirmed $26, reservable on recreation.gov, no electric/water hookups, vault toilets; added $9 extra-vehicle fee, 16-night stay limit, season 5/16-9/30, no drinking water/dump/showers. Site count 17 (FS) vs 20 (catalog) noted, count left. Not stated: max rig length. Concessionaire Rocky Mountain Recreation Company (ExplorUS). Alerts: none for Spire Rock or Storm Castle Rd. Note trimmed.
